Context before (unchanged): From my infancy I was imbued with high hopes and a lofty ambition; but how am I sunk!

1818 text: Oh! my friend, if you had known me as I once was, you would not recognize me in this state of degradation.

1831 text: Oh! my friend, if you had known me as I once was, you would not recognise me in this state of degradation.
